
```{r}
library(readr)
library(here)
```

```{r}
labels <- read_tsv(here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature.tsv"))
# HDT_label = 1 for Direct (HDT) matches.
# exception: "fostaminitib" is manually labeled as 1 due to a drug name typo
# in the literature (misspelled drug name in abstract prevented detection)
# https://doi.org/10.3390/antibiotics9090550
labels$HDT_label <- ifelse(
  labels$search_type == "Direct (HDT)" | labels$drug_name %in% c("fostamatinib"),
  1, 0
)
```

```{r}
method_lists <- list(
  CMAP_microarray = CMAP_indivSig_TB_microarray$ranked_pert[1:20],
  CMAP_RNAseq     = CMAP_indivSig_TB_RNAseq$ranked_pert[1:20], # add aggr microarray and aggr RNAseq

  Pearson_microarray = Cor_pearson_indivSig_TB_microarray$ranked_pert[1:20],
  Pearson_RNAseq     = Cor_pearson_indivSig_TB_RNAseq$ranked_pert[1:20],

  Spearman_microarray = Cor_spearman_indivSig_TB_microarray$ranked_pert[1:20],
  Spearman_RNAseq     = Cor_spearman_indivSig_TB_RNAseq$ranked_pert[1:20],

  NCS_microarray = NCS_indivSig_TB_microarray$ranked_pert[1:20],
  NCS_RNAseq     = NCS_indivSig_TB_RNAseq$ranked_pert[1:20],

  Tau_microarray = Tau_indivSig_TB_microarray$ranked_pert[1:20],
  Tau_RNAseq     = Tau_indivSig_TB_RNAseq$ranked_pert[1:20],

  WCS_microarray = WCS_indivSig_TB_microarray$ranked_pert[1:20],
  WCS_RNAseq     = WCS_indivSig_TB_RNAseq$ranked_pert[1:20]
)

integrative_pred = read_tsv(here("results/final_high_confidence_drug_predictions.tsv"))
integrative_pred_list <- integrative_pred$drug_name[1:20]

method_lists$Integrative <- integrative_pred_list
```

```{r}
# collect all predicted drugs (top 20 single-score lists + integrative)
all_predicted_drugs <- unique(unlist(method_lists))

# restrict labels to evaluated drugs only
labels_eval <- all_predicted_drugs[all_predicted_drugs %in% labels$drug_name]
all_labeled <- all(all_predicted_drugs %in% labels$drug_name)

print(paste0(
  "Do all predicted drugs have labels? ",
  all_labeled
))

missing_drugs <- setdiff(all_predicted_drugs, labels$drug_name)

print(missing_drugs)

# count positives in evaluated set
num_pos <- sum(labels[labels$drug_name %in% labels_eval,]$HDT_label, na.rm = TRUE)
print(paste0("Size of evaluated set: ", length(labels[labels$drug_name %in% labels_eval,]$HDT_label)))
print(paste0("Number of positives in evaluated set: ", num_pos))

```

```{r}
compute_metrics <- function(drug_list, positives, K) {
  drug_list <- tolower(drug_list)
  
  topk <- drug_list[1:K]
  
  hits <- sum(topk %in% positives)
  
  precision <- hits / K
  recall <- hits / length(positives)
  
  c(Precision = precision, Recall = recall)
}
```

```{r}
labels$drug_name <- tolower(labels$drug_name)
positives <- labels$drug_name[labels$HDT_label == 1]

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

rank_df <- lapply(names(method_lists), function(method) {
  
  drugs <- tolower(method_lists[[method]])
  
  data.frame(
    Method = method,
    drug_name = drugs,
    Rank = seq_along(drugs)
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Keep only known positives
rank_df <- rank_df %>%
  filter(drug_name %in% positives)
rank_df$Score <- gsub("_.*", "", rank_df$Method)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# order Score by median rank (lower = better)
rank_df <- rank_df %>%
  mutate(Score = gsub("_.*", "", Method)) %>%
  group_by(Score) %>%
  mutate(median_rank = median(Rank, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

rank_df$Score <- reorder(rank_df$Score, rank_df$median_rank)

ggplot(rank_df, aes(x = Score, y = Rank)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_y_reverse() +  # rank 1 at top
  coord_flip() +       # flip axes
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of ranks for known drugs in the top 20 predictions across methods",
    x = "Method",
    y = "Rank (Top = 1)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}
rank_df <- rank_df %>%
  mutate(
    Score = gsub("_.*", "", Method),
    DataType = ifelse(grepl("RNAseq", Method), "RNAseq",
                      ifelse(grepl("microarray", Method), "Microarray", "Integrative")),
    Method_full = ifelse(DataType == "Integrative",
                         "Integrative",
                         paste(Score, DataType, sep = "_"))
  )
rank_df <- rank_df %>%
  group_by(Method_full) %>%
  mutate(median_rank = median(Rank, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

rank_df$Method_full <- reorder(rank_df$Method_full, rank_df$median_rank)
```

```{r}
ggplot(rank_df, aes(x = Method_full, y = Rank, fill = Score)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = score_colors) +  
  scale_y_reverse() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of ranks for known drugs in the top 20 drugs across methods and technologies",
    x = "Method",
    y = "Rank (Top = 1)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
Ks <- c(5, 10, 15, 20)

results <- lapply(Ks, function(k) {
  res <- lapply(method_lists, function(dl) {
    compute_metrics(dl, positives, K = k)
  })
  
  df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, res))
  df$Method <- names(method_lists)
  df$K <- k
  df
})

results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

results_df$DataType <- ifelse(grepl("RNAseq", results_df$Method),
                             "RNAseq", "Microarray")

results_df$Score <- gsub("_.*", "", results_df$Method)

scores <- unique(results_df$Score)

score_colors <- c(
  "Integrative" = "black",
  setNames(
    brewer.pal(length(scores), "Dark2"),
    scores
  )
)


# Flag Integrative methods
results_df$IsIntegrative <- grepl("Integrative", results_df$Method)

ggplot(results_df, aes(x = K, y = Precision,
                       group = Method)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = Score), linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(
    shape = ifelse(IsIntegrative, "Integrative", DataType),
    color = ifelse(IsIntegrative, "Integrative", Score)
  ), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Integrative" = "black",
    setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(unique(results_df$Score)), "Dark2"),
             unique(results_df$Score))
  )) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Integrative" = 15,   # square
    "RNA-seq" = 16,       # circle
    "Microarray" = 17     # triangle
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Precision@K across method-technology combinations",
    x = "K",
    y = "Precision",
    color = "Score",
    shape = "Data type"
  )
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)

results_df_plot <- results_df %>%
  bind_rows(
    results_df %>%
      filter(grepl("Integrative", Method)) %>%
      mutate(DataType = "RNAseq")
  )

ggplot(results_df_plot, aes(x = K, y = Precision, group = Method)) +
  
  # Non-integrative methods (faded)
  geom_line(
    data = subset(results_df_plot, !grepl("Integrative", Method)),
    aes(color = Score),
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(results_df_plot, !grepl("Integrative", Method)),
    aes(color = Score),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Integrative (highlighted)
  geom_line(
    data = subset(results_df_plot, grepl("Integrative", Method)),
    aes(color = Score),
    linewidth = 1.5,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(results_df_plot, grepl("Integrative", Method)),
    aes(color = Score),
    size = 3.5,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ DataType) +
  scale_color_manual(values = score_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Precision@K across methods by technology",
    x = "K",
    y = "Precision",
    color = "Score"
  )

```
